# ShortsVid

> ShortsVid is an AI-powered short video generator for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels. It helps creators make faceless videos with AI-generated scripts, voiceovers, captions, visuals, and background music.

ShortsVid is built for creators, marketers, and businesses that want to publish short-form video faster without manual editing.

## Product Summary

ShortsVid lets users generate vertical short-form videos for social platforms. The workflow includes topic selection, script generation, voiceover selection, caption styling, visual generation, and final video rendering.

The product is especially relevant for:

- faceless content creators
- YouTube Shorts creators
- TikTok marketers
- Instagram Reels creators
- brands repurposing content into short videos
